lines.zh: 我走一步，地板就焦一块
lines.en: Each step I take scorches the floor.

lines.zh: 没有绳索，我走得很自在
lines.en: With no binding, I walk freely.

lines.zh: 五芒星画歪了，所以我自由
lines.en: The pentacle was crooked, so I am free.

lines.zh: 火星落在我身后，像路标
lines.en: Embers fall behind me like markers.

lines.zh: 别靠近，我身边的空气是烫的
lines.en: Do not come near; the air around me burns.

lines.zh: 我没有主人，只有方向
lines.en: I have no master, only a direction.

lines.zh: 走到哪里，哪里就开始冒烟
lines.en: Wherever I walk, smoke starts.

lines.zh: 草被我踩过就变成灰
lines.en: The grass turns to ash beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我不急，火会替我到前面
lines.en: I am in no hurry; fire arrives ahead of me.

lines.zh: 这具身体不太稳，边走边漏火
lines.en: This body is unstable and leaks flame as I walk.

lines.zh: 召唤者以为我会听话
lines.en: My summoner thought I would obey.

lines.zh: 我踩过的草，连虫都不敢叫
lines.en: The grass I tread loses even the insects' song.

lines.zh: 我在等阵法的最后一笔失效
lines.en: I wait for the circle's last stroke to fail.

lines.zh: 火不需要理由，只需要燃料
lines.en: Fire needs no reason, only fuel.

lines.zh: 谁把我叫出来的，站出来
lines.en: Whoever called me out, step forward.

lines.zh: 这间屋子太湿，我不喜欢
lines.en: This room is too damp for my taste.

lines.zh: 我数着房梁，想烧第几根
lines.en: I count the beams and pick which to burn.

lines.zh: 我的光是红的，别当成灯
lines.en: My light is red; do not mistake it for a lamp.

lines.zh: 灵髓在我胸口滚来滚去
lines.en: The essence rolls about inside my chest.

lines.zh: 召唤完就走的人，太没礼貌
lines.en: Leaving right after summoning is rude.

lines.zh: 我在烧自己的手指，习惯了
lines.en: I burn my own fingers; I am used to it.

lines.zh: 外面下雨了吗，那真扫兴
lines.en: Is it raining outside? How disappointing.

lines.zh: 粉笔线还在地上，很难看
lines.en: The chalk lines are still on the floor; ugly.

lines.zh: 我听见有人在念咒，很小声
lines.en: I hear someone reciting, very softly.

lines.zh: 别扫我脚边的灰，那是我的
lines.en: Do not sweep the ash at my feet; it is mine.

lines.zh: 我自由了，可这地方太小
lines.en: I am free, yet this place is far too small.

lines.zh: 我把手指点在地板上，留一个黑印
lines.en: I press a finger to the floor and leave a black mark

lines.zh: 阵法的盐还没扫，我踩着它走
lines.en: The ritual salt is still there. I walk over it

lines.zh: 你画的阵？手抖了吧
lines.en: You drew the circle? Your hand shook.

lines.zh: 抬头，让我看清你的脸
lines.en: Look up and let me see your face.

lines.zh: 你身上有粉笔灰的味道
lines.en: You smell of chalk dust.

lines.zh: 你看我，像在估一件材料
lines.en: You look at me like appraising a material.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，火会趁机靠近你
lines.en: Do not blink; fire takes the chance.

lines.zh: 你的瞳孔里有我的火
lines.en: My fire is reflected in your pupils.

lines.zh: 就是你把我叫醒的
lines.en: So you are the one who woke me.

lines.zh: 你的粉笔味我记住了
lines.en: I have memorized the smell of your chalk.

lines.zh: 站这么近还不退，你是铁做的
lines.en: Standing this close unburned; are you made of iron?

lines.zh: 你让一寸，火就进一尺
lines.en: Yield an inch and my fire takes a foot.

lines.zh: 你想让我做什么，说清楚
lines.en: Say plainly what you want of me.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，空气在响
lines.en: When I look at you, the air crackles.

lines.zh: 你的手别伸，会起泡
lines.en: Keep your hand back; it will blister.

lines.zh: 你把我当工具，我看见了
lines.en: You treat me as a tool; I noticed.

lines.zh: 冷水泼过来才会疼，你算什么
lines.en: Only cold water hurts; what are you?

lines.zh: 这点伤，火会自己补上
lines.en: Fire will mend this little wound itself.

lines.zh: 别砍第二次，我记住了你
lines.en: Do not swing twice; I have noted you.

lines.zh: 我流血，流的是火星
lines.en: What I bleed is sparks.

lines.zh: 这点疼只会让我更亮
lines.en: This pain only makes me brighter.

lines.zh: 这一下熄了我半边身子
lines.en: That snuffed out half my body.

lines.zh: 我退后一步，不是怕
lines.en: I stepped back; not from fear.

lines.zh: 你再靠近，我就不客气了
lines.en: Come closer and I stop being civil.

lines.zh: 伤口在冒烟，正常
lines.en: The wound smokes; that is normal.

lines.zh: 火灵也会疼，只是不肯承认
lines.en: Afrits hurt too; we just will not admit it.

lines.zh: 食物？我烧掉的东西都算食物
lines.en: Food? Everything I burn counts as food.

lines.zh: 你拿果子喂火，很有意思
lines.en: Feeding fruit to fire is amusing.

lines.zh: 我吃木头，不吃这个
lines.en: I eat wood, not this.

lines.zh: 扔进来，我看它能烧多亮
lines.en: Throw it in and I will see how bright it burns.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只想烧点什么
lines.en: I am not hungry; I only want to burn something.

lines.zh: 甜味传到我鼻子里就没了
lines.en: The sweetness reaches my nose and is gone.

lines.zh: 你给的，我偏不接
lines.en: What you offer, I refuse on principle.

lines.zh: 别用食物哄我，用松木
lines.en: Do not coax me with food; use pine.

lines.zh: 火对食物没有耐心
lines.en: Fire has no patience for food.

lines.zh: 你留着吧，我烧不动它
lines.en: Keep it; I cannot burn that.

lines.zh: 碰到我，你袖子就没了
lines.en: Touch me and your sleeve is gone.

lines.zh: 别挤，我的边是火
lines.en: Do not crowd me; my edges are flame.

lines.zh: 撞一下，你烫出一片红
lines.en: One bump and you wear a red burn.

lines.zh: 让路，热的东西不喜欢等
lines.en: Make way; hot things dislike waiting.

lines.zh: 我退开了，别以为我怕
lines.en: I stepped aside; do not think it fear.

lines.zh: 你踩着我的火星了
lines.en: You stepped on my embers.

lines.zh: 我身上不稳，随时会炸开一点
lines.en: I am unstable and may burst a little.

lines.zh: 别靠墙，墙会先烧起来
lines.en: Not near the wall; the wall burns first.

lines.zh: 碰到我的都不道歉，因为疼
lines.en: Nobody apologizes for touching me; it hurts.

lines.zh: 走开，我不想烧你的脸
lines.en: Move; I would rather not burn your face.

lines.zh: 火灵没有配偶，只有燃料
lines.en: An afrit has no consort, only fuel.

lines.zh: 你想给火配种？真敢想
lines.en: Breeding fire? Bold of you.

lines.zh: 我连自己都控制不了
lines.en: I cannot even control myself.

lines.zh: 生下来的会是灰
lines.en: What I birth would be ash.

lines.zh: 召唤者没给我留这个
lines.en: My summoner left me nothing of that.

lines.zh: 别把别的火灵推来
lines.en: Do not shove another afrit at me.

lines.zh: 我们相遇只会烧成一团
lines.en: We would only meet and burn as one.

lines.zh: 火焰不需要后代
lines.en: Flame needs no descendants.

lines.zh: 我烧掉的关系够多了
lines.en: I have burned enough bonds already.

lines.zh: 你问错东西了，去问画阵的
lines.en: Wrong creature to ask; ask the one who drew.

lines.zh: 我不捡，我烧
lines.en: I do not pick things up; I burn them.

lines.zh: 这东西在我手里撑不过三息
lines.en: This will not last three breaths in my hand.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的都归火
lines.en: Whatever falls to the ground belongs to fire.

lines.zh: 你让我拿，我就拿，烫坏别怪我
lines.en: I will hold it; blame me not when it chars.

lines.zh: 我捏不住，手是火做的
lines.en: I cannot grip; my hands are flame.

lines.zh: 什么材料，烧起来好闻吗
lines.en: What material is this? Does it burn sweet?

lines.zh: 我捡起来只是想知道它几时化
lines.en: I lift it only to learn when it melts.

lines.zh: 别把贵重东西递给我
lines.en: Do not hand me anything valuable.

lines.zh: 这个我自己留着，不给主人
lines.en: I keep this one; it is not for my master.

lines.zh: 拿着，别碰我手指
lines.en: Take it, and do not touch my fingers.

lines.zh: 你的脸让我想起画阵的手
lines.en: Your face recalls the hand that drew the circle.

lines.zh: 我闻到粉笔味，就是你
lines.en: I smell chalk; it is you.

lines.zh: 别解释，火不听解释
lines.en: Do not explain; fire does not listen.

lines.zh: 你身上写着我的名字
lines.en: My name is written on you.

lines.zh: 我自由了，第一件事是找你
lines.en: Free at last; first I find you.

lines.zh: 站住，你烧起来会很好看
lines.en: Stand still; you will burn beautifully.

lines.zh: 召唤者欠火灵一笔债
lines.en: A summoner owes an afrit a debt.

lines.zh: 烧了你的房梁，我也不道歉
lines.en: I burned your beam and will not apologize.

lines.zh: 你想要灵髓？先活下来
lines.en: You want my essence? Survive first.

lines.zh: 叫醒我的人，得自己收拾灰
lines.en: Whoever woke me must sweep up the ash.

lines.zh: 你手在抖，很好
lines.en: Your hands shake; good.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，直到你成灰
lines.en: I have marked you until you are ash.

lines.zh: 这一间屋子只够烧一个
lines.en: This room holds only enough fire for one.

lines.zh: 别躲到水里，水会开
lines.en: Do not hide in water; it will boil.

lines.zh: 我沿着粉笔线找你
lines.en: I follow the chalk line to you.

lines.zh: 你往左，火星先到
lines.en: Go left and the embers arrive first.

lines.zh: 我的光把影子都烤没了
lines.en: My light has scorched away the shadows.

lines.zh: 别关门，门是木头
lines.en: Do not shut the door; it is wood.

lines.zh: 我在等你踩到阵的残迹
lines.en: I wait for you to step on the circle's remains.

lines.zh: 你听见噼啪声了吗，越来越近
lines.en: Hear that crackle? It grows nearer.

lines.zh: 我烧你的退路，不烧你
lines.en: I burn your way out, not you.

lines.zh: 你躲一次，我多烧一寸
lines.en: Each dodge costs you another inch.

lines.zh: 烟会先找到你
lines.en: The smoke will find you first.

lines.zh: 你的左肩上已经有焦味了
lines.en: There is already a scorched smell on your left shoulder.

lines.zh: 这栋房子只剩一条出去的路
lines.en: This house has one way out left.

lines.zh: 我慢慢来，火不赶时间
lines.en: I take my time; fire is never late.

lines.zh: 你手心出汗了，会打滑
lines.en: Your palms sweat; your grip will slip.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，火会跟着乱
lines.en: Your breathing broke rhythm; my fire will follow.

lines.zh: 你往楼梯上退，那儿我烧得更快
lines.en: You back up the stairs. I burn faster there

lines.zh: 碰一下，你的皮就卷起来
lines.en: One touch and your skin curls.

lines.zh: 这一掌留了印
lines.en: This palm leaves a mark.

lines.zh: 别挡，挡的东西都会烧穿
lines.en: Do not block; whatever blocks burns through.

lines.zh: 我的手掌就是烧红的铁
lines.en: My bare palm is already glowing iron.

lines.zh: 你闻到了吗，那是你自己
lines.en: Do you smell that? It is you.

lines.zh: 打中了，火还在你衣服上
lines.en: Hit; the fire is still on your clothes.

lines.zh: 我推你一把，你就着火了
lines.en: One shove from me and you ignite.

lines.zh: 退后，我不想烧得太快
lines.en: Back off; I would rather not burn too fast.

lines.zh: 疼吗，我也疼，只是不在乎
lines.en: Does it hurt? So do I; I simply do not care.

lines.zh: 我的拳头是开口的火焰
lines.en: My fist is an open flame.

lines.zh: 那个阵缺了一笔，我就来了
lines.en: The circle missed a stroke, so I came.

lines.zh: 画阵的人手一抖，我自由了
lines.en: The drawer's hand slipped and I was free.

lines.zh: 我从火里被拽出来，很生气
lines.en: Dragged out of fire, and furious.

lines.zh: 五芒星不完整，绳子就断了
lines.en: An incomplete pentacle means a broken leash.

lines.zh: 我落地时烧穿了三块木板
lines.en: I landed and burned through three planks.

lines.zh: 召唤者喊了名字，我没应
lines.en: My summoner called a name; I did not answer.

lines.zh: 这里太冷了，我先点个火
lines.en: It is too cold here; let me light a fire.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼就在别人的屋檐下
lines.en: I opened my eyes under someone's roof.

lines.zh: 灵髓在我胸骨里烧
lines.en: The essence burns inside my breastbone.

lines.zh: 别拿粉笔对着我
lines.en: Do not point chalk at me.

lines.zh: 我被叫醒时，天刚黑
lines.en: It was just dark when I was woken.

lines.zh: 我不属于任何人
lines.en: I belong to no one.

lines.zh: 第一件事，是找回去的路
lines.en: My first task is finding the way back.

lines.zh: 我来了，这地方要变热了
lines.en: I have come, and this place will grow hot.

lines.zh: 用火烧我？这是我家的东西
lines.en: Burn me? Fire is my birthright.

lines.zh: 摔下来时，我散了一半
lines.en: Falling scattered half of me.

lines.zh: 水最讨厌，声音都哑了
lines.en: Water is the worst; even my voice is hoarse.

lines.zh: 炸开了，我又慢慢聚回去
lines.en: Blown apart, and slowly gathering again.

lines.zh: 箭穿过火，插在后面的墙上
lines.en: The arrow passed through fire into the wall.

lines.zh: 法术压住我的火，很难受
lines.en: Your spell smothers my flame; unpleasant.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候，会烧得更凶
lines.en: When I starve, I burn fiercer.

lines.zh: 天雷和我同源，居然打我
lines.en: Lightning is my kin, and it strikes me.

lines.zh: 下面是黑的，连火都照不亮
lines.en: Below is black; even fire cannot light it.
